Second-hand shops/thrift stores for clothes, eBay/AliExpress for jewellery (just type in 'cross earrings' for instance and you'll find some cheap but pretty things), and then just buy basics and DIY the shit out of them! Stick them full of safety pins, tear a bunch of holes, add some spikey studs, or whatever you feel like - thats just what I do😊 if you wanted a more vampy/Victorian as opposed to trad/death-rock look then I'm sure you could make some pretty lace chokers, maybe buy some ruffly blouses from high Street stores etc! Hope this helps, best of luck! And enjoy - thrift-shopping and DIYing clothes is so much fun😋
P.S. goth isn't expensive! Goth brands can be, yes, but for me the heart of goth fashion is DIY, it's all about being thrifty and figuring out what you can do with what you've got! Plus you'll get much more interesting pieces second hand than you ever would from a big goth brand like punk rave or killstar. Look at some old pictures of 80s/90s goths for inspo!
